hooks.logic:
Count up "inCurrDistanceTurn".
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let bpConfsIdx be the register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
Let v be the count "inCurrDistanceTurn".
Let v2 be if the register's 'isHigh' then list at bpConfsIdx's 'turnToChangeAltitudeAiArg' else list2 at bpConfsIdx's 'turnToChangeAltitudeAiArg'.
If the numeric entry v2 in aiArg is less than v, then choose state 13 next and stop.
Let v3 be run helper.
If bpConfsIdx is not v3, then
  Run helper2 on v3.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
